html:
Tibia Observer is an Android and iOS app that informs players about certain activities or events in Tibia through notifications on their mobile devices, without requiring them to log into the game or website. These notifications can be personalized for the user's preferences.

In the app dashboard you can find buttons to check your notifications, two boxes with the active Boosted Creature and Boosted Boss and a section listing your favourite characters. By adding a favourite character you are able to check whether they are online or training at an Exercise Dummy, if they already collected their daily reward, and their stamina status.

The app supports linking three accounts per device and accounts can only be linked to one device. Accounts linked to devices that are inactive for 360 days or more will be automatically unlinked.

Beta Phase

The app was first announced on September 22, 2021 and confirmed few players were invited for a closed beta. A second article was published on December 13, 2021 with additional information and confirming a public beta is planned to happen in the course of Spring 2022.

On February 23, 2022 the public beta phase started where CipSoft invited 2,000 accounts from their private test server pool to test the app. One week later, on March 02, another batch of players was invited. The invitees were limited as a technical precaution to ensure things would go smoothly before inviting a larger number of accounts. Additionally, a bug report thread was created on the forums.

On March 22, 2022 the public beta phase was made available for all players. Along with that, a new FAQ section was added with instructions on how to link your accounts to Tibia Observer.

On April 27, 2022 the public beta phase ended as the app was officially released. Despite planned to be released to both Android and iOS on launch, CipSoft's iOS app application is yet to be approved, making the app available only on Android for now. One week later the iOS app got approved and available for download.

With the launch, NPC Gaberiel was reintroduced to the game and is distributing Observer Tapestry to anyone greeting him.

Notification Types

These are the notifications featured in Tibia Observer:

  • Raids: Raid announcements from the Cyclopedia map can be shown through the app if you have unlocked the respective area. You can define specifically which areas you would like to be notified about.
  • Events: The app can remind you about the next double XP/skill, rapid respawn and double loot event, as well as world events. It can also tell you when a world event has been successfully completed on a game world.
  • Char Bazaar: If you have certain attributes in mind which your desired character needs to have, simply create a search and be informed once a fitting auction is created. You can select filters for game world and type, level, vocation and skill. Once you have found an interesting offer, the app will take you to the Tibia website where you can proceed to bid.
  • Mini World Changes: Do not miss out on mini world changes by defining which of them interest you and receiving a notification on server save about them. All mini world changes listed on the world board at the Adventurer's Guild are notified, with the exception of Bank Robbery.
  • Houses: Are you looking to buy a new home or simply want to stay informed about the world of real estate? Simply tell the Tibia Observer when your dream house is up for auction to not miss your chance to put in a bid.
  • Offline training: Optimise your offline training by staying notified about how long your characters have been training and how long they can still keep going.
  • Forum: Receive notifications immediately when somebody has responded in one of your threads to be able to reply in a timely manner. You can decide from which forum sections you would like to get messages.

Security

Tibia Observer was designed to run in a safe way, thus it doesn't require any password or other sensitive data to work. Instead, the app is linked to your account via a token which is generated in the account management on the Tibia website. This link can also be revoked again at once through the account management.

Your account can only be connected to one installation of the Tibia Observer at a time, and you can link up to three accounts to one such installation.
